titulo: Two trips, and nothing hits the floor
caption:
Two trips, and nothing hits the floor

"One trip. You've got it." "Two trips." Nothing hit the floor.

The second trip costs a minute, and the one-trip dare is how the box lands on the stairs.

For whoever makes two trips instead of one risky one.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A stairwell. Two boxes, tan and light blue, sit on the floor at the left. A navy block figure with narrowed eyes in the middle, and a bubble says one trip. be brave. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers with a bubble that says two trips, then carries the tan box to the right, walks back and carries the blue one. The navy figure's eyes go wide and a bubble says huh. nothing dropped. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me taking two trips.
